releaseNotes:
CantosTV 1.5.59

Posters
- Movies with no artwork now show their real poster instead of the title on
  a plate. The provider had the picture all along - it just wasn't in the
  catalogue listing - so the tile fetches it as you browse, and remembers it.
- Applies to the movie grid, the trending rails, Continue Watching and
  Recently Watched. The few films nobody has a poster for keep the plate.
